I don't know if this belongs here, but couldn't get any other suitable category for this. This is a read of monthly chart of EUR/USD. Any comments will be greatly helpful.

[1]: It is DBR which price respected twice but both the bounces didn't go far. 2nd bounce is especially and after it, price just engulfed the level. Marked the area where price made the decision to break through it as [2]. [1] after becoming a swap level was respected at FTB in [3] [2]: DBD which broke through the lower demand level [1]. Price respected it in FTB. [3]: Liquidity spike to swap area [1] after compresison. created a RBD at [4] [4]: RBD or DBD, depending on how one looks at it. got respected then engulfed then respected again as swap level. [5]: FL, was engulfed, then price touched it again before continuing its move up then again retraced back and continued. [6]: RBD which was respected twice then engulfed. [7]: DBR which was respected and the 2nd bounce from it started the whole up movement. [8]: FL or RBR which created enough momentum for price to break through supply area [5] and reach supply area [4] [9]: DBR created after price retraced to swap area [5] [10]: RBD or quasimodo higher high. [11]: where price decided to go through compression. [12]: LL of QM but price engulfed it and tested the high of QM [11] before breaking through it. [13]: FL or decision made by price to break down support. Price respected it once before engulfing it. [14]: RBD which showed good momentum down. [15]: DBD, price stalled around for a bit before continuing its down momentum. Price respected it once before breaking through it and testing supply area [14] [16]: FL, it is the supply area where price has touched multiple times. Price currently approached this with a compression.

[00]: The highest high supply area (according to my charts ) which began the move down.
